From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>

Cc: Linda Gomez <linda.gomez@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & priorities

Hi Marissa / Nikhil,

Thanks for the call today \u0012 appreciate the clear walkthrough. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying Qs:

Pain points we confirmed:
- High per-token cost on our current provider when serving personalized responses at scale (peak traffic during support hours).
- Unreliable latency during bursts; impacts customer-facing SLAs.
- Lack of an easy rollout path for model updates across environments (staging -> prod).

Goals:
- Reduce inference cost by ~30% while keeping quality within a 2-3% delta.
- Ensure p95 latency under 300ms for 1k concurrent sessions.
- Establish a repeatable MAP for pilot -> production with named owners and dates.

Questions:
1) Can you share a sample MAP template and a ballpark timeline for a pilot?
2) Any security/compliance pre-reqs we should prepare (SOC2, audit logs)?

Thanks \u0012 looping in Linda (security/compliance) and our procurement mailbox for next steps.

Best,
Samir
Director of ML Engineering
ACME Corp

Hi Samir / Linda \u0012 thanks for the excellent summary. Confirming next steps and attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a high-level pricing quote.

What we heard (short):
- Cost reduction (~30%) and p95 latency <300ms for 1k concurrent sessions.
- Need secure onboarding and audit logs; SOC2 evidence will be required for procurement.

Proposed MAP (attached: ACME_MAP_v1.pdf) \u0012 highlights:
- Milestone 1 (Pilot alignment): Data access + test account provisioned \u0012 owner: ACME (Samir) \u0012 target: 2027-03-10
- Milestone 2 (Pilot execution): 2-week pilot with observed traffic shape \u0012 owner: Redwood (Nikhil) \u0012 target: 2027-03-24
- Milestone 3 (Evaluation & pricing): cost/latency report + decision meeting \u0012 owner: ACME + Redwood \u0012 target: 2027-03-31
- Milestone 4 (Prod rollout): contract signature + production cutover plan \u0012 owner: Procurement (Linda) / Redwood Sales Ops \u0012 target: 2027-04-15

Security/compliance: we\u0019ll provide SOC2 report, architecture diagram, and audit-log sample ahead of Pilot alignment.

Action items for Samir: please confirm stakeholders above and whether the dates look feasible. If procurement needs a separate doc, we can prepare a one-page security packet.

Attaching: ACME_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), redwood-pricing-quote.pdf

Thanks!
Marissa Cole
